notes: M7-P7 gradual unlock schedule. Welcome Week: existing students (any sign-off, or a belt above white) get every earned ability on day 1, but meet these dojo systems one per day, in this order. A system the student's belt hasn't opened yet (minTier) is skipped. One new thing per day in total, shared with Sensei's Lessons. Kind wording only: no countdowns, no 'you missed'. Later systems plug in here (milestone 10).
